2.08.betting_forecast: 7/4 Mumayaz, 3/1 Safari Dream, 6/1 Strike, 8/1 Forever My Prince, 9/1 Optimatum, 10/1 Ararat, 14/1 Arabian Cobra, 16/1 Distant
2.08.spotlight_verdict: The return to this track could suit last year's winner Safari Dream (second choice) and Land Of Magic should come on for her recent comeback effort at Windsor. However, MUMAYAZ (nap) won well at Leicester five days ago and looks the one to beat under a 4lb penalty. Strike has each-way claims if bouncing back to form. [Harry March]

horses.spotlight_comment: Won at Thirsk (6f, good) last June before following up at Chester (6f, good) a week later; well beaten in the Ayr Bronze Cup on his final start for Hugo Palmer and he beat only one rival home at Bath on his stable debut 27 days ago; visor back on (replacing cheekpieces worn last time).
horses.breeding: gr g Dark Angel - Dr Simpson

horses.spotlight_comment: Front-runner who won twice over 6f at Southwell last year when trained by Robert Cowell, the most recent coming in October off 2lb higher; visor worn on his final start for that yard is left off for this stable debut (bought for 9,500gns).
horses.breeding: b g Kodiac - Recife

horses.spotlight_comment: Two wins from 18 starts; dropping to 5f wouldn't have suited at Lingfield in February but he was too free at Kempton (6f) when last seen 78 days ago; switches back to turf with others preferred.
horses.breeding: ch g Rumble Inthejungle - Distant Thunder

horses.spotlight_comment: Signed off 2025 with a claiming success at Leicester (7f, soft) in October on his final start for Eve Johnson Houghton; two fair efforts over 7f since joining this stable and now drops back in trip on ground that he could probably do with being a bit softer than forecast.
horses.breeding: b g Showcasing - One Kiss

horses.spotlight_comment: Her four wins have included one over this C&D (good to soft) and she's now 1lb below the most recent of those successes; left the impression her first start for 192 days was needed when weakening at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 10 days ago and she should appreciate this drop in grade; contender.
horses.breeding: b m Land Force - Kelowna

horses.spotlight_comment: Had a luckless passage at Bath last month but had a clearer run through when winning at Leicester (6f, good to firm) five days ago, travelling strongly and doing it comfortably; carries a 4lb penalty for that success and looks the one to beat.
horses.breeding: b g Tamayuz - Rashaaqa

horses.spotlight_comment: Won at Leicester (1m, good to firm) last June when trained by Charlie Johnston and he went close at Southwell (1m, AW) on his final start for that yard; beat only one rival home on his stable debut 174 days ago and now has his first try over 6f; cheekpieces left off.
horses.breeding: b g Wootton Bassett - Beyond Limits

horses.spotlight_comment: Dual C&D winner last year (including this race), the most recent coming off a 2lb higher mark than today's; fair third at Kempton (7f) on his return and ran a solid race when fourth at Bath 27 days ago; claims back at this track (form figures here read 3114).
horses.breeding: b g Bungle Inthejungle - Grandmas Dream

horses.spotlight_comment: Four-time winner from 40 starts; made an encouraging start to the campaign when second at Bath last month but ran below his best at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 10 days ago; without a win since July 2024 and needs to bounce back from that latest effort.
horses.breeding: gr g Lethal Force - Midnight Fling

2.40.betting_forecast: 5/2 Gallivanted, 4/1 Cruden, 5/1 Personal Best, 11/2 Anniversary, 13/2 Mr Freedom, 7/1 Just An Hour, 12/1 Tryfan, 25/1 Alfred
2.40.spotlight_verdict: Personal Best proved reliable in her first full season's racing last term and should have more to offer this year, while Just An Hour is not fully exposed at this trip and also warrants respect. However, Gallivanted and CRUDEN fought out a good duel last time and the latter is taken to gain his revenge in this historic handicap.[Richard Russell]

horses.spotlight_comment: Won sole visit here (1m handicap in 2019); in the care of Ian Williams when landing 2m York handicap in August 2022 and ran a mighty race when pipped in the Ebor a fortnight later; pulled up at Chester the following month and seen just three times since, including when down the field in two starts for this yard last year; drops in grade from falling mark; watch the market on return.
horses.breeding: gr g Aussie Rules - Policy Term

horses.spotlight_comment: Won Newmarket maiden on his debut in 2024 but hasn't kicked on from good juvenile form; fair efforts when fifth in quite valuable AW handicaps in February and March but he proved a disappointing favourite on return to turf when beaten 14l at Beverley (also 2m, good to soft) last month; others hold greater appeal.
horses.breeding: b g Sea The Moon - Lixirova

horses.spotlight_comment: Won maiden Flat and hurdle race for Jessie Harrington in 2024; big run for this yard when keeping on well from the rear to give Gallivanted a fright at Goodwood (1m6f, good; 25-1) a fortnight ago; had to come down the outer that day and it's no guarantee his old adversary will confirm those placings.
horses.breeding: b g Time Test - Amami

horses.spotlight_comment: Hurdles winner for this yard; resumed Flat career with close third at Thirsk (1m4f) on handicap debut in this sphere last month and justified strong support when narrowly beating Cruden over this trip at Goodwood (also good) a fortnight ago; unexposed and the best is probably yet to come.
horses.breeding: b g Sixties Icon - Waitingforachance

horses.spotlight_comment: Winner over hurdles for Paul Nicholls and fences for Gavin Cromwell but pulled up at big prices in both hurdle starts for this yard; visor deployed on his belated handicap debut in this sphere.

Four-time winner who last scored over 1m2f at Windsor (good to firm) off just 1lb lower in July; runner-up over C&D in October, however, and confirmed this trip holds no fears when second again at Nottingham (also good) 18 days ago; player.
horses.breeding: gr g Cima De Triomphe - Intellingencia

horses.spotlight_comment: Six-time Flat winner who scored a fifth win on turf when taking Sandown handicap (1m6f, good) off 2lb lower in July 2024; also a multiple winner over hurdles who was on the premises when taking heavy last-flight fall at Plumpton just over one year ago; interesting to see how he goes in the market ahead of this comeback.

Won sole start at two (heavy) and a series of solid efforts from 1m3f to 1m6f last year included win at Ffos Las (1m6f, soft; acts on good) in June; rain would likely increase her chances but still respected on this reappearance.
horses.breeding: b f Time Test - Spring Run

horses.spotlight_comment: Three-time winner whose sole success on turf came over C&D (good to firm) just under one year ago; also scored off this mark on AW (1m6f) in September but has been very in and out on last four starts, including when tried in a hood (removed) and beaten 32l in valuable AW event last time; drops back down in grade from lower turf mark and can make presence felt if on a going day.
horses.breeding: b g Nathaniel - Rhagori

3.18.betting_forecast: 7/4 American Psycho, Orthodox, 9/2 Mobadir, 6/1 The Bookkeeper, 16/1 Oakford, 25/1 On The Queue Tee.
3.18.spotlight_verdict: A field of newcomers and the betting should provide a big piece of the puzzle. The tentative order of preference is ORTHODOX followed by American Psycho and Mobadir, but market interest in any of the remainder, notably The Bookkeeper, should be taken seriously.[Richard Russell]

horses.spotlight_comment: March foal by Mehmas; £130,000 breeze-up 2yo; eighth foal; half-brother to four winners including Space Cowboy (6f AW 2yo; RPR 100), Ikagai (7f 2yo; 95) and Sayem (7f-1m including 2yo; 86); dam unraced half-sister to Japanese 1m Grade 2 winner Mikki Charm, out of 6f Listed winner; plenty of appeal on paper and yard already 4-9 with its juveniles this year; likely debutant.

Early February foal by No Nay Never; first foal; dam 7f AW/1m turf winner (RPR 100), sister to 6f/7f winner Foreign Diplomat, half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Be My Gal, is granddaughter of 5f Group 3 winner; the oldest runner in the field and respected yard sent out a winning newcomer at Nottingham on Saturday.

78,000euros March foal by Dark Angel; 60,000gns yearling; fourth foal; closely related to 5.7f/6f winner Emporess (including 2yo; RPR 72), half-brother to 5f AW 2yo winner Sound And Vision (75); dam placed 5f/7f 2yo (73), half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Empowering, out of 7f Listed winner; first 2yo runner of the season for this yard; heed any market signals.

March foal by Massaat; second foal; sister to 8.6f AW 2yo winner Snaafy (RPR 65); dam US 5.5f turf 2yo winner, half-sister to Listed-placed 7f 2yo winner Frescobaldi, out of maiden half-sister to Group-placed 6f/1m2f winner Silver Grey; stable is 0-7 with its 2yos this year; market may provide some clues ahead of this introduction.

175,000gns late February foal by Havana Grey; 175,000euros yearling; third foal; half-brother to German 1m winner Hello Sweetheart; dam Listed-placed 5f 2yo winner (RPR 92), sister to Group-placed 5f 2yo winner Unbreak My Heart, half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 2 winner Heartache; the most expensive of this field at auction and yard always to be feared in these events.

38,000euros early March foal by Sioux Nation; £75,000 yearling; third foal; dam Listed-placed 7f winner (including 2yo; RPR 97), closely related to 7f-9.4f winner Swift Emperor, half-sister to useful 1m-1m2f winner London Icon, out of unraced half-sister to 5f Listed winner Dairine's Delight; yard among the winners with its juveniles; betting likely to provide a good guide to this newcomer's prospects.

3.53.betting_forecast: 8/13 Wareeth, 3/1 Ancestor, 8/1 Pacific Storm, 12/1 Who's Lope, 20/1 Ramli, 25/1 Brother Jack.
3.53.spotlight_verdict: William Haggas won this last year and his 200,000gns yearling Ancestor (second choice) is interesting on his debut, but WAREETH sets a good standard. Archie Watson's colt looked a smart prospect on his debut at Newcastle but found the step up to Listed company too much in the Feilden Stakes last month. Pacific Storm has a nice pedigree and is another one to note on his debut, while Who's Lope has been gelded since his debut and is bred to be suited by the step up in trip. [Harry March]

horses.spotlight_comment: Gelding by Sea The Stars; 200,000gns yearling; third foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Reach For The Moon (7f 2yo Group 3) and Chalk Stream (Australian 1m4f Listed), out of 7f Listed winning sister to Oaks runner-up Flight Of Fancy; stable won this last year with Arabian Force; interesting newcomer.

Sixth foal; half-brother to 11.6f-2m winner High Wells (RPR 87); dam Group-placed 6f/7f winner (101), half-sister to useful 5f/6f winner Sohraab and useful 7f/1m winner Pango; well held in a bumper at Kempton (2m, good) 61 days ago and now switches to the Flat; others preferred.

Zarak colt who cost 100,000euros as a yearling; ninth foal; closely related to French 1m4f winner Parabellum (RPR 108), half-brother to three winners including Paix (French 1m4f-1m7f including Group 3; 104) and Psara (French 1m4f; 96); dam French 1m2f-1m7f winner (including Group 3; 109); yard won this in 2024 and there's lots to like on paper.

Third in a bumper at Huntingdon (2m, good) last month when trained by Michael Keady and he didn't run badly when fifth on his Flat/stable debut at Southwell (1m4f, AW) 19 days ago; drops in trip and may be one for handicaps.

Sea The Stars colt who cost 510,000gns as a yearling; looked a nice prospect when scoring by 14l on his debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in March but found the step up to Listed company too much in the Feilden Stakes 29 days ago, albeit he was keeping on again at the line which bodes well for this slightly longer trip; carries a penalty but sets the standard returned to a novice.
horses.breeding: b g Sea The Stars - Tidal Stream

horses.spotlight_comment: Half-brother to Who's Glen (RPR 100) who showed his best form at 2m/2m2f; looked in need of the experience on his debut at Kempton (1m, AW; 22-1) in December and now steps up in trip having since been gelded; market should be informative.

4.28.betting_forecast: 13/8 Pierian, 11/4 Alma Latina, 4/1 Take A View, 7/1 Blue Noon, 16/1 Counter Intuitive, Persian Flaw, 20/1 Liveinthelight, 25/1
4.28.spotlight_verdict: An interesting fillies' novice in which ALMA LATINA is selected to get off the mark having shown plenty of promise behind a nice prospect on her debut at Sandown. She's out of a 1m2f Listed winner and can hand Ralph Beckett a third win in this race since 2022. The nicely bred Pierian went close on her debut and is next on the list, while Take A View shaped encouragingly at Newbury and is open to progress. Persian Flaw should be monitored in the betting on her debut. [Harry March]

horses.spotlight_comment: Dam 1m2f Listed winner; showed plenty of promise after a slow start when third of 10 behind a nice prospect at Sandown (1m2f, good; 33-1) 20 days ago; open to progress and she's interesting for a stable that won this in 2022 and 2024.

115,000gns yearling; sister to 1m 2yo/1m2f winner Herring Island; didn't show much and finished tailed off on her debut at Kempton (1m3f, AW; 28-1) 36 days ago; needs to leave that effort well behind in first-time blinkers; stable also runs Alma Latina.

Promising fourth of 12 on her debut at Leicester (7f, good to soft) in September and filled that same position on her reappearance at Newmarket (1m2f, good; raced freely) 13 days ago; may yet do better.
300,000gns yearling; never featured after a tardy start on her debut at Kempton (1m, AW; 17-2) 190 days ago and has been off since; bred to be suited by this longer trip and she may do better.

6yo by The Gurkha; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Julie's Love (US 1m/1m2f stakes) and Julissima (German 1m), out of unraced half-sister to Melbourne Cup winner Rekindling and Irish Derby runner-up Golden Sword; best watched on her belated debut.

Always behind on her debut at Ascot (1m, soft) in September but showed more when fifth of eight at Kempton (1m3f, AW) 45 days ago; that form hasn't worked out and she may be one for handicaps after this.

Dam 6f 2yo and 1m3f (German Oaks) winner (RPR 102); sent off 150-1 when beating only one rival home on her debut at Sandown (1m2f, good; behind Alma Latina) 20 days ago and needs to have taken a big step forward; one of three for her stable.

3yo by Al Kazeem; third foal; half-sister to 1m4f AW winner Arazzo (RPR 76); dam 1m4f/1m6f winner (84), closely related to 10.5f Listed winner Alkandora, half-sister to useful 1m winner Persian Royal, out of Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner; interesting on her debut for a trainer who runs three; watch the betting.

Dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (including Irish Oaks); showed plenty and was beaten only a neck by her stablemate on her debut at Wetherby (1m2f, good to firm; 5-1) 18 days ago; nicely bred and she looks a lively contender.

Half-sister to five winners including Patrick Sarsfield (1m-1m2f including Group 3; RPR 114), Oz Legend (1m-1m4f; 89) and Tooreen Katie (1m4f; 82); never dangerous when eighth on her debut at Sandown (1m2f, good; 80-1) 20 days ago; open to improvement; stable runs three.

Sister to 7f/1m2f 2yo winner One World (RPR 91), half-sister to winners Time Lock (1m4f including Group 3; 113) and Continuite (1m; 93); shaped with plenty of encouragement when third on her debut at Newbury (1m2f, good; 33-1) 27 days ago and looks likely to improve; shortlisted.

5.03.betting_forecast: 9/4 Market House, 3/1 Kotari, 4/1 Fair Dinkum, 5/1 Zhang Fei, 8/1 Shaffron, Stage Show.
5.03.spotlight_verdict: The tentative selection is course winner KOTARI who returns to the Flat on a handy mark, with Market House next on the list now dropping in grade. Fair Dinkum has gained all four of his wins over further and Zhang Fei gained his sole win on the Flat back in 2022. [Harry March]

horses.spotlight_comment: His two wins last year include one here over 1m6f in October and he was runner-up off 2lb higher than today's mark at Kempton (2m, AW) next time; respectable fifth at Goodwood 13 days ago but he isn't certain to be suited by this drop back in trip.
horses.breeding: b g Australia - Wannabe Posh

horses.spotlight_comment: His three wins were all on the Flat in 2024, including here on heavy ground over 1m2f; failed to build on his comeback run when well beaten over hurdles at Kempton 52 days ago and the hood returns on this switch back to the Flat; makes some appeal from a good mark.

Doubled his tally over hurdles when winning in a first-time visor at Plumpton last month but he was below his best back on the Flat at Goodwood (1m6f, good) 13 days ago; drops back down in grade with a place chance.
horses.breeding: b g Tamayuz - Saree

horses.spotlight_comment: Hinted at ability in five starts last year but she didn't help her chance by hanging right at Southwell (1m4f, AW) on her reappearance 16 days ago; up in grade.
horses.breeding: b f Sea The Moon - Shamakiya

horses.spotlight_comment: Sole win from 32 starts came over hurdles at Exeter (2m7f, good to firm) in October but he's been held in three starts since and now returns to the Flat for the first time since June 2024.

He's struggled over hurdles since rejoining this stable but he ran a respectable race at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) 10 days ago; needs to build on that effort now stepping back up in trip and he's without a win on the Flat since 2022.
horses.breeding: b g Showcasing - Floria Tosca

5.40.betting_forecast: 6/1 Apex Star, Dusk Damsel, Rogue Rebellion, 7/1 Stock Market, 8/1 Fullstop, 9/1 Wadirumm, 10/1 Frankali, Maid In Devon, 12/1
5.40.spotlight_verdict: The drop back to 6f could suit FULLSTOP who has posted two respectable efforts since switching to more positive tactics. Dusk Damsel is next on the list after a good run on her handicap debut. Maid In Devon, Stock Market, Rogue Rebellion and Frankali are also considered, while market support should be noted for Follow My Heart [Harry March

horses.spotlight_comment: Six-race maiden who pulled too hard when midfield on her reappearance at Leicester (7f, good) 31 days ago; she may come on for that outing and this drop back to 6f may help.
horses.breeding: b f Lope Y Fernandez - Increasing

horses.spotlight_comment: Hinted at ability in three maiden runs over further in March and she ran well when runner-up behind a progressive rival at Lingfield (6f, AW) on handicap debut 16 days ago; claims if backing that up on her first start on turf.
horses.breeding: b f Twilight Son - Visala

horses.spotlight_comment: Big prices and beaten about 12l in each of her three runs earlier in the year (7f/6f); makes her turf/handicap debut having been off for 80 days and she's best watched unless the market speaks in her favour.
horses.breeding: b f Sergei Prokofiev - Cross My Heart

horses.spotlight_comment: Shaped with promise when fourth of eight on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in March and ran respectably when fifth of 17 at Nottingham (5f, good) 26 days ago; steps back up in trip with place claims.
horses.breeding: ch f Sergei Prokofiev - Favourite Girl

horses.spotlight_comment: Raced freely before weakening into seventh on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (7f) in March, and she again failed to settle when beating only one rival home there nine days ago; drops in trip for turf debut.
horses.breeding: b f Golden Horn - Lapidary

horses.spotlight_comment: 0-7; promise in handicaps on the AW but below her best at Kempton (7f, AW) 45 days ago; now 2lb lower and drops back to 6f; others preferred.
horses.breeding: b f Palace Pier - Prance

horses.spotlight_comment: Sole win from eight starts came at Lingfield (5f, AW) in January on his second start for James Owen; stepped forward from his debut for this yard when beaten a neck at Bath (5.5f, good) ten days ago and should have no issue with the return to 6f.
horses.breeding: b c Ardad - Powerful Dream

horses.spotlight_comment: Ex-Aidan O'Brien; struggled on his first four starts for this stable but ran better when third in the returning blinkers at Windsor (5f, good to firm) ten days ago; steps back up to 6f and looks a contender.
horses.breeding: b g No Nay Never - Azenzar

horses.spotlight_comment: Best effort in three starts for Clive Cox came when a modest sixth at Kempton (7f, AW) in December but she was well beaten there in January; has since switched yards and drops back to 6f for her handicap/turf debut; watch the betting.
horses.breeding: b f Acclamation - Voler Mon Coeur
